## Shorter output: --detail and --dense

For a shorter read, add `--detail brief` (one line per section) or `--detail compact`. `--dense` swaps in a shorter text where a doc ships one. Use them when pasting CLI output into a web-based AI tool like ChatGPT or Claude.

Short output for pasting into AI conversations:
```bash
npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling --full --detail brief
npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component Dialog --detail compact
npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs principles --dense
```
